en.name: Seitan
en.summary: Cooked seitan keeps 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and 12–18 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). No food safety agency publishes storage times for seitan, so both figures are borrowed wholesale from soy meat substitutes, the closest published analogue.
en.pantry: Not a room-temperature food. Cooked seitan is a moist, low-acid, cooked protein, and it behaves exactly as any other cooked protein does in a warm kitchen: the two-hour rule applies, one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Being plant-based changes nothing about that. An unopened vacuum pack keeps to its printed date in the chilled cabinet, not in the cupboard. Dry vital wheat gluten flour is a different product entirely and is stored as a flour.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept in its cooking broth in a sealed box — the broth keeps the surface from drying into a rubbery skin and carries the seasoning back into the seitan as it sits. An unopened vacuum pack keeps to its printed date. Once opened, treat it as a leftover from that day, not from the date on the pack, and reheat portions right through to steaming hot rather than warming the whole box repeatedly.
en.freezer: 12–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F), and seitan freezes very well — in its broth for the best result. The texture firms slightly on thawing, which most people prefer: it becomes chewier and more meat-like rather than spongy. Kept continuously frozen it stays safe well beyond that window; the limit is quality, as the surface dries and freezer-burns if it is not covered by liquid. Freeze in portion-sized boxes so you take out only a meal at a time.
en.thawing: Thaw overnight in the fridge, or simmer straight from frozen in a broth or a stew. Never thaw on the counter. Seitan thawed in the fridge and still at or below 4 °C (40 °F) may be refrozen with some quality loss; anything thawed warm must not be.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell when the box is opened.
A slimy or sticky surface, or cloudy, ropy broth.
Any mould, in which case the whole box goes out.
A grey, dried, leathery surface on a frozen piece that was not covered by liquid.
tips: Store and freeze it in its broth; it keeps the texture and the flavour.
Freeze in meal-sized portions rather than one large box.
Reheat right through to steaming hot, not just warm.
Seitan is wheat gluten and is not safe for anyone with coeliac disease.

faq.a: 3–4 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 12–18 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Both figures are read across from soy meat substitutes.
Yes, 12–18 months at −18 °C (0 °F), ideally in its broth. The texture firms slightly, which most people consider an improvement.
No — it is made of wheat gluten, which is the opposite. It is not safe for anyone with coeliac disease or a wheat allergy.

zh.name: 麵筋（seitan）
zh.summary: 煮熟的麵筋放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 3～4 天，−18 °C 冷凍是 12～18 個月。沒有任何食安機關公布過麵筋的保存時間，所以這兩個數字都是整組借自大豆素肉——資料裡最接近的對照。
zh.pantry: 這不是常溫食品。煮熟的麵筋是含水量高、低酸的熟蛋白質，在溫暖的廚房裡它的行為和任何熟蛋白質一模一樣：適用兩小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有一小時。「植物做的」完全不改變這件事。未開封的真空包要放冷藏櫃、依印製日期，不是放櫃子。乾的活性麵筋粉是完全不同的產品，按麵粉保存。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，連著煮它的湯汁一起裝密封盒——湯汁能避免表面乾成一層橡皮，也會在放置期間把調味重新帶回麵筋裡。未開封的真空包依印製日期。一旦拆封，就當成「從今天起算」的剩菜，而不是包裝上的日期；回熱請一份一份加熱到中心冒熱氣，不要整盒反覆加熱。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 12～18 個月；麵筋非常耐凍，連湯汁一起凍效果最好。解凍後質地會稍微變緊實，而多數人喜歡這個變化：它變得更有嚼勁、更像肉，而不是變成海綿。只要全程沒退冰，超過這段時間仍然安全；限制它的是品質——沒有被湯汁蓋住的表面會變乾、凍燒。請按一餐的份量分盒冷凍。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍丟進湯裡、燉鍋裡煮。絕對不要在檯面上解凍。在冷藏解凍、且維持在 4 °C 以下的可以再冷凍，只是品質打折；回溫過的絕對不行。
spoilage: 打開盒子聞到酸味或發酵味。
表面變得黏滑或黏手，或湯汁變濁、可以牽絲。
冷凍時沒被湯汁蓋住的部分，表面發灰、乾硬、像皮革。
tips: 連湯汁一起保存和冷凍；口感和味道都留得住。
按一餐的份量分裝，不要只用一個大盒。
回熱要熱到中心冒熱氣，不是溫溫的就好。
麵筋就是小麥麵筋，乳糜瀉患者絕對不能吃。

faq.a: 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 12～18 個月。兩個數字都是比照大豆素肉而來。
可以，−18 °C 下 12～18 個月，最好連湯汁一起。解凍後質地會稍微變緊實，多數人覺得那反而更好。
不是，正好相反——它就是用小麥麵筋做的。乳糜瀉或小麥過敏的人不能吃。
